// diagnostic

E0372

This `{body}` body needs braces.

What

This `{body}` body needs braces.

Why

use `->` for one effect statement; braces make a multi-statement or scoped body's boundary visible to readers, editors, and the compiler.

Fix

Write `-> statement` for one statement, or wrap the body in `{ ... }`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0372: tests/ui/control_body_needs_braces.stderr.

    |             ^^^^^
 Why: use `->` for one effect statement; braces make a multi-statement or scoped body's boundary visible to readers, editors, and the compiler.
 Fix: write `-> statement` for one statement, or wrap the body in `{ ... }`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.
